name: Release Matcher

settings.label: Sources list URL
settings.description: Web address of the list of sites to search. Leave as default unless you use your own.

settings.label: Custom server URL (Optional)
settings.description: Address of your own pre-built search server. When set, episodes load from it instead of searching live.

settings.label: ameNZB API key (Optional)
settings.description: Optional personal key to also search ameNZB. Stays on your device and is never shared.

settings.label: Include Usenet results
settings.description: Also search Usenet for rare or older episodes.

settings.label: Extra feed URLs (Optional)
settings.description: Optional extra feed addresses to search alongside the main list, separated by commas.

settings.label: Use episode ID mappings
settings.description: Uses AniZip to match seasons and episode numbers more accurately.

description: Finds matching anime episodes across multiple sources and ranks the best downloads first.
